name: Radi-Eye (Look & Cross)
summary: Looking at an object pops up a radial menu; the user looks at a menu item and then moves the head cursor across it to select, all without hands.
howItWorks: Gaze dwelling on an object or invoking gesture opens a pop-up radial interface around it. The user pre-selects a widget by looking at it, which reveals a head-controlled cursor; moving the head across the gazed widget completes the selection (Look & Cross). Because the eyes and head normally move at an offset, simply looking does not trigger anything. Crossing can continue into head-controlled manipulation (e.g. a slider), and gaze can open nested levels. Demonstrated in a VR media player, an AR smart home controller and a city-building game; a study (N=12, HTC Vive Pro Eye) varying radial size and orientation found fast, accurate selection with low error.

relationships.note: Both select by head-crossing; Radi-Eye uses gaze to arm the target first.
